list.label: Log stream selector
list.description: LogQL stream selector for Engram's logs; match it to how your log shipper labels them.

panels.title: Appview up
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the appview's metrics listener.

panels.title: Index lag p95
panels.description: Time from a repo commit to its memory being searchable (incremental syncs). Near-instant when write notifications arrive; up to the poll interval when they don't.

panels.title: Rejected notifications (1h)
panels.description: Authorities don't retry a rejected notification; the write waits for the next poll. not_granted: the space's authority hasn't let the appview read it, so its writes are never searchable.

panels.title: Memories becoming searchable
panels.description: Index lag: from a repo commit to the change being in the index.

panels.title: Notifications by result
panels.description: accepted and deferred are good; anything else means a notification was refused, or (not_granted) arrived for a space the appview isn't allowed to read.

panels.title: Notification registrations
panels.description: Requests asking authorities to send write notifications; renewed about every 12 hours per space.
